summary: Make a combinational circuit explain its output for each input combination.
objective: Build a 3D gate board where toggling Boolean inputs updates a truth-table row and connected output.
example_prompts: Build a 3D gate board where toggling Boolean inputs updates a truth-table row and connected output.

entities.name: Gate blocks
entities.guidance: Use recognizable labeled gate symbols on shallow extrusions; sockets and wire endpoints must stay connected.

entities.name: Signals
entities.guidance: Represent 0 and 1 with labels plus contrasting line styles; no brightness-only truth encoding.

entities.name: Truth table
entities.guidance: Highlight the row computed from actual inputs, with gate expression adjacent.

state_contract.model: Acyclic Boolean graph, explicitly typed gate operators and input bits; zero-delay evaluator.
state_contract.authority: One canonical model owns semantic values; derive geometry and labels from it. Keep presentation transforms separate.
actions: Select AND, OR, XOR or NOT.

invariants: Gate output comes from the Boolean evaluator, not wire animation.
Reject unknown operators, non-bits and combinational cycles.
Every visible socket refers to a declared input/output port.
motion_guidance: Signal pulses are illustrative highlights after evaluation; do not assign electrical propagation speed.
Reduced motion replaces pulses with a stable active-path outline.
known_limits: No voltage, transistor, hazard or timing model.
Gate truth tables must be checked on all supported bit combinations when implemented.
Authored guidance; no scene runtime or visual verification has run for this recipe.

claims.statement: Boolean equations can specify combinational logic using AND, OR, XOR and unary NOT.

object_craft.structure: Use recognizable labeled gate symbols on shallow extrusions; sockets and wire endpoints must stay connected.
object_craft.material: Matte labeled gate housings, dark socket collars and clearly differentiated wire states using text plus line style; emissive glow is optional.
